entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Sikh Empire, a political institution in India during Maratha and Sikh Empires (1799–1849). Grew from Maharaja Ranjit Singh captures Lahore and founds the Sikh Empire and Third Battle of Panipat — Ahmad Shah Durrani defeats the Maratha Confederacy. Led to the emergence of East India Company.
